title: Schema.org Course
description: A description of an educational course which may be offered as distinct instances which take place at different times or locations, or through different media.

provider.description: The service provider of the course.

courseCode.description: The identifier for the Course used by the course provider.

educationalLevel.description: The level in terms of progression through an educational or training context.

educationalCredentialAwarded.description: A description of the qualification or credential awarded upon completion.

numberOfCredits.description: The number of credits or units awarded by a Course.

hasCourseInstance.description: An offering of the course at a specific time and place.

about.description: The subject matter of the course.

inLanguage.description: The language of the course content.

teaches.description: The item being described is intended to help a person learn the competency or learning outcome.

totalHistoricalEnrollment.description: The total number of students that have enrolled in the history of the course.

financialAidEligible.description: A financial aid type or program which students may use to pay for the course.

availableLanguage.description: A language someone may use with or at the item.

offers.description: An offer to provide this course.

sameAs.description: URL of a reference Web page that unambiguously indicates the item's identity.

CourseInstance.description: An instance of a Course offered at a specific time and place.

name.description: The name of the course instance.

courseMode.description: The medium or means of delivery of the course instance (e.g., online, onsite, blended).

courseWorkload.description: The amount of work expected of students.

instructor.description: A person assigned to instruct or provide educational instruction.

location.description: The location of the course instance.

courseSchedule.description: Represents the schedule for the course.
